---
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
    keep_tex: false
geometry: "margin=2.5cm"
params:
  id: "cur"
  def_dir: "definitions"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
path   <- file.path(params$def_dir, paste0(params$id, ".qmd"))
lines  <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
delims <- which(trimws(lines) == "---")
meta   <- yaml::yaml.load(paste(lines[(delims[1]+1):(delims[2]-1)], collapse = "\n"))

fields <- list(
  list(key = "definition",          label = "Definition"),
  list(key = "numerator",           label = "Numerator"),
  list(key = "denominator",         label = "Denominator"),
  list(key = "unit_of_measure",     label = "Unit of Measure"),
  list(key = "data_source",         label = "Data Source"),
  list(key = "frequency",           label = "Frequency"),
  list(key = "disaggregation",      label = "Disaggregation"),
  list(key = "sdg_who_ref",         label = "SDG / WHO Reference"),
  list(key = "notes_caveats",       label = "Notes & Caveats")
)
```

# `r if (!is.null(meta$indicator_name)) meta$indicator_name else params$id`

**Indicator Code:** `r if (!is.null(meta$indicator_code)) meta$indicator_code else "—"`

---

```{r results='asis'}
for (f in fields) {
  val <- meta[[f$key]]
  if (!is.null(val) && nzchar(trimws(as.character(val)))) {
    cat("## ", f$label, "\n\n")
    cat(as.character(val), "\n\n")
  }
}
```
